messages.subject: tags script
parts:
I am trying to write a loop in a tags script but whenever it has to loop, it does not work.

ui,R
tags$script('            
    Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("siteList",     
              function(a) { 
                  var i =1;
                  if(i<10){
                   i++
                   window.open(a[i]);
                }

  }
  ); ')

server.R
  observe({
    input$mydata
   
    a <- c("aa", "bb", "cc")
    session$sendCustomMessage(type='siteList', a) 
    
    
    
  })

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: tags script
parts:
There might be more issues, but for starters - you need to wrap your javascript code in "HTML()" because the "<" character currently gets converted to "<"
You should also add a semiconol after "i++"

messages.subject: Re: tags script
parts:
The call to HTML() should immediately follow the tags$script.

tags$script(HTML(Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler(...)))

Thank you Dean, I was able to get it to work. I will post the working code below in case anyone needs it in the future.

ui,R
  tags$script(HTML('            
    Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("siteList",     
      function(a) {   
        for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { 
            window.open(a[i]);
         }
      } 
    );
  '))
